rawClinicalNotes: 78-year-old female with a history of hypertension (managed with lisinopril 10mg daily), type 2 diabetes (metformin 500mg twice daily), mild cognitive decline noted in 2024, history of two falls in the past 12 months. Uses a walker for ambulation. Allergic to penicillin (rash). Recent labs (May 2026) show HbA1c 7.1, eGFR 58. Family reports occasional confusion at night (sundowning). No recent hospitalizations.

dailyActivities: Three structured meals in the dining room
Evening quiet time with orientation cues
carePlan.medicalSupervision: Daily vitals (BP, glucose) by charge nurse; weekly medication review by attending physician; monthly care plan review by interdisciplinary team.
carePlan.emergencyProtocol: Code Blue for cardiac/respiratory arrest. Fall protocol: do not move resident, call nurse immediately, document time of fall and any observed injury. Hypoglycemia protocol: check glucose, give 15g fast-acting carbs if <70 mg/dL, recheck in 15 min.
carePlan.nutritionPlan: Diabetic diet, 1800 kcal/day, carbohydrate-controlled. Three meals plus afternoon snack. Thickened liquids as needed (Stage 1 dysphagia diet).
carePlan.mobilityAssistance: Walker required at all times. One-staff assist for transfers. Non-slip footwear. Bed alarm for nighttime fall risk.
